multi_entity_note: Besides the judge, the record names other people in different roles (the nominating president, the predecessor whose seat was vacated, and others).

resume.name.rationale: The record heading names the subject; other names are the nominating president, predecessor, or judges clerked for.

resume.law_institution.rationale: The Education line with the J.D. names the law school.

resume.law_year.rationale: The J.D. year is given in the Education section; other years are career, birth, or service dates.

resume.undergrad_institution.rationale: The Education line with the B.A. names the undergraduate institution.

resume.undergrad_year.rationale: The B.A. year is given in the Education section; other years play different roles.

resume.first_judgeship_start.rationale: The commission date is stated for the Article III judgeship (the earlier magistrate judge service carries no commission, only years); nomination and confirmation dates are different roles.

resume.latest_position.value: Judge, U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York
resume.latest_position.rationale: The Federal Judicial Service heading gives the latest federal position; the magistrate judge service ended when it began.
